entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: An elf who mutated her own body with self-experimentation and became the guildmaster of the Simic Combine and speaker of Zonot Three on Ravnica.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of biomancers, led by Vannifar.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the Simic Combine and other guilds reside.

entities.name: Zonot Three
entities.description: Vannifar's home zonot, where the laboratory of Navika lies.

entities.name: Zonot Seven
entities.description: Location where Zegana summoned Vannifar for a reprimand.

entities.name: Zonot Four
entities.description: A zonot threatened by Golgari incursion.

entities.name: Navika
entities.description: The nautilus-shaped laboratory in Zonot Three that is the hub of the Guardian Project.

entities.name: Guardian Project
entities.description: Simic project creating sapient humanoid hybrids to form an army of highly evolved soldiers.

entities.name: Roalesk
entities.description: The first successful result of the Guardian Project.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Former Prime Speaker of the Simic Combine, whose ideas Vannifar counterbalanced; later assassinated at Karlov Manor.

entities.name: Vorel
entities.description: Representative sent for Vannifar to the guild meeting during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who spoke with Vorel during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Resurrected as the new Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Detective who invited Vannifar to Vitu-Ghazi to learn the truth of the murders.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The central dryad of Trostani, who organized the murders in retribution for those she considered traitors during the Invasion.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who with Etrata defeated Oba.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: Defeated Oba together with Kaya.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war against Bolas in which the Simic were loyal allies.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion during which many Simic willingly became Phyrexianized.

entities.name: Karlov Manor
entities.description: Site where Zegana was assassinated.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Where Alquist Proft revealed the truth of the murders.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose incursion threatened Zonot Four.

events.summary: Vannifar's faction loses influence when the Living Guildpact emerges, and she retreats to Zonot Three to continue experimentation.
events.quote: Vannifar herself retreated to Zonot Three to continue what she still saw as a pressing matter of guild survival.

events.summary: Zegana summons Vannifar to Zonot Seven for a reprimand before the Speakers' Chamber.
events.quote: Zegana had to summon Vannifar to Zonot Seven for a reprimand before the Speakers' Chamber.

events.summary: Vannifar makes Zegana's leadership the subject of open debate and is voted the new Prime Speaker.
events.quote: A vote was called, and Vannifar was made the new Prime Speaker .

events.summary: The entire Simic Combine aligns with the adaptationists under Vannifar.
events.quote: Under Vannifar's leadership, the entirety of the Simic Combine has aligned with the adaptationists .

events.summary: Vannifar authorizes the Guardian Project at Navika, creating humanoid hybrid soldiers; Roalesk is the first success.
events.quote: The first successful result of the Guardian Project was Roalesk .

events.summary: During the War of the Spark, Vorel represents Vannifar at the guild meeting and tells Ral she had prepared for war long before Bolas.
events.quote: Vorel told Ral Zarek that Vannifar was a fighter and had been preparing for war long before Bolas was known to be a threat.

events.summary: Vannifar represents the guild at the resurrection of Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact.
events.quote: Vannifar served as the representative for the guild at the resurrection of Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact .

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion many Simic become Phyrexianized; Vannifar and Zegana settle their grievances and Zegana researches a cure.
events.quote: Vannifar and Zegana settled their old grievances

events.summary: Vannifar keeps her position after the invasion with the other guilds' support.
events.quote: With the support of the other guilds, she managed to maintain her position after the invasion

events.summary: Vannifar is present at Karlov Manor when Zegana is assassinated and avoids questioning.
events.quote: she was present at Karlov Manor when Zegana was assassinated, and avoided questioning when the Azorius began investigating.

events.summary: Alquist Proft reveals at Vitu-Ghazi that Oba organized the murders; Oba attacks and captures Vannifar, who is freed after Kaya and Etrata defeat Oba.
events.quote: When Oba attacked the guild leaders, Vannifar was captured, but was freed after Oba was defeated by Kaya and Etrata.

relations.quote: Vannifar is the current guildmaster of the Simic Combine , and speaker of Zonot Three, on Ravnica .

relations.note: Old grievances and rivalry over leadership, later settled.
relations.quote: Vannifar and Zegana settled their old grievances
The work of the Guardian Project, authorized by Prime Speaker Vannifar

relations.note: First successful result of the project.
relations.quote: The first successful result of the Guardian Project was Roalesk .
Vorel was sent as a representative for Vannifar.

relations.note: Oba attacked and captured the guild leaders including Vannifar.
relations.quote: When Oba attacked the guild leaders, Vannifar was captured

relations.note: Oba was defeated by Kaya and Etrata.
relations.quote: was freed after Oba was defeated by Kaya and Etrata.
